messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square that maximizes the minimum area among all C(13,3)=286 triangles is the arrangement of 13 points on the triangular lattice (specifically, the hexagonal grid) with affine-rectangular boundary conditions fitting in [0,1]², scaled so the minimum gap between collinear-adjacent points is 1/4. This lattice arrangement yields a minimum triangle area of 1/32, and no configuration of 13 points in the unit square can achieve a strictly larger minimum triangle area."}
